description: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs in your text with live updating stats, plus an estimated reading time at 200 words per minute.

faqs.a: Any sequence of non-whitespace characters counts as one word, so hyphenated words count as a single word.
Reading time is calculated at an average speed of 200 words per minute, rounded to the nearest display unit.
No. All counting happens in your browser and your text never leaves your device.

howto: Paste or type your text into the box.
Stats update automatically as you type.
Check words, characters, sentences and paragraphs.
Use Clear to reset or Copy to copy your text.
title: Word Counter
